q01.summary_en: You woke up in a stranger's bed. Someone is moving about the house.

steps.name_en: Talk to the man in the house
steps.text_en: The old man is here in the house with you. Walk up to him and press E to talk.

q02.summary_en: Marlow wants to see you grow something before you leave the island.

steps.text_en: Go out of the front door. Marlow is standing by the path, just outside it. The field is the patch of bare earth west of the house.

steps.name_en: Hoe some soil in the field
steps.text_en: Stand in the field west of the house with the hoe in your hand and press Space. One swing turns a whole row.
Take the seeds in hand from your hotbar, stand on the turned soil and press Space.

steps.name_en: Tell Marlow the seeds are in
steps.text_en: Marlow is standing by the path outside your front door.

q03.summary_en: The carrots are in. They need a drink, and a little patience.

steps.text_en: Take the can to your carrots west of the house and press Space. Did rain water them already? Then harvest one when it is ripe.
When the carrots have come up, stand by them with the sickle in hand and press Space.
Marlow is by the path outside your front door.

q03c.summary_en: You carry ten things in hand and five in your backpack. Marlow shows you where the rest can go.

steps.name_en: Hear what Marlow has to say
steps.text_en: Marlow is by the path outside your front door.

steps.name_en: Put something away in a chest in the house
steps.text_en: The chests are in the house, two by the fireplace, a crate and one by the bed. Press E at one and drag something into it.
Marlow is by the path outside your front door.

q04.summary_en: Marlow has taught you what he can on the island. Bloomshire is across the water, and he is going with you.

steps.text_en: Marlow is by the path outside your front door.
The rowing boat is tied up on the south shore of the island, below the house. Stand next to it and press E.

s_storehouse.summary_en: Marlow said the Storehouse in Bloomshire keeps a chest for you. Handy when your hands are full in town.

steps.name_en: Put something in your chest at the Storehouse
steps.text_en: East side of town, straight south of the Bank. Inside, the chest is on the right above a barrel. Press E and drag something in.

q05.summary_en: Marlow wants you to go round town and meet people. There's no hurry.

steps.name_en: Talk to Marlow by the jetty
steps.text_en: Marlow is on the jetty where the boat came in, at the south end of town by the river.
Maren is on the west bank north of the bridge, Odette by the bridge, Hazel and Bram east of the square, and Wren by the south jetties.

q06.summary_en: Bloomshire isn't only farming. Marlow wants you to try a real day of it.

steps.name_en: Ask Marlow about a day here
steps.text_en: Marlow's new house is west of the river, south of the main road, near the allotments.
Hazel's shop is just east of the square. The fields are north of the square, by the greenhouse. The river runs through the west of town.

steps.name_en: Tell Marlow how the day went
steps.text_en: Marlow's new house is west of the river, south of the main road, near the allotments.

q07.summary_en: You've met the town and done a day's work. Maren thinks it's time you made yourself useful.

steps.text_en: Maren's house is on the west bank of the river, north of the bridge.

q07t.summary_en: Tamsin says anyone can cook if they'll stand at a stove long enough.

steps.name_en: Talk to Tamsin at the Bakery
steps.text_en: The Bakery is on the west bank, right by the bridge, on the north side of the main road.
At the stove in the Bakery press E. Fried Fish takes two Carp. Put them in the pot, press Cook, and press Cook again when it is done.
Tamsin is behind the counter in the Bakery, by the bridge.

ff01.summary_en: Something odd has washed up below Maren's house, and she wants you to take a look.

steps.text_en: Maren's house is on the west bank of the river, north of the bridge.

steps.name_en: Look at the find by the river
steps.text_en: Just below Maren's house, at the water's edge on the west bank. Look for something grey lying in the grass.
Maren is at her house on the west bank of the river, north of the bridge.

ff02.summary_en: Maren thinks Wren's family knows the mark on the plank.

steps.text_en: Wren's cottage is on the east bank of the river, down by the south jetties.

steps.name_en: Bring Wren three fish and the plank
steps.text_en: Chub, Perch and Sunfish all bite in the river through town. Wren is at her cottage by the south jetties.

ff03.summary_en: Tobin's trail began at the lodge in Whisperwood. His log holds half of an old song for waking the stones. A hunter kept the rest.

steps.text_en: Take the main road west out of town, over the bridge and past the Bakery. It runs straight into Whisperwood.

steps.name_en: Find the marker at the lodge
steps.text_en: Just inside Whisperwood, beside the path by the old lodge. Look for an old post with a birdhouse nailed to it.

steps.name_en: Look in the chest by the hunter's fire
steps.text_en: Follow the main path west through the wood, over the stream and past the crossroads, to the camp at its far end. The chest is by the fire.

ff04.summary_en: An old song in two halves, one in Tobin's log and one in the hunter's journal: which stone to wake first, and which last. It is written in riddles.

steps.name_en: Wake the six stones in order
steps.text_en: North of the crossroads, west of Mirror Pond. Wake them in the song's order: Tobin's Trail Log, then the Hunter's Journal.
The moonstone is the knot of crystal in the middle of the ring of stones.

ff05.summary_en: "The caps grow where the light does not." That sounds like Mushroom Hollow, in the far west of Whisperwood.

steps.name_en: Find the mark among the caps
steps.text_en: Go past the Hunter's Camp to the far west of the wood, where the trees turn teal. Look for a cut stump among the giant mushrooms.
The Apothecary is the teal-roofed house on the far west side of town, north of the main road.
Silvercaps are small pale blue mushrooms, thickest in Mushroom Hollow. Glowcaps are small and purple, in the wood and at Moonmere.

ff06.summary_en: Juniper's tonic only works at night, by still water. Mirror Pond is the stillest water in the wood.

steps.name_en: Use the tonic there at night
steps.text_en: Follow the stream north from the bridge in the middle of Whisperwood to the pond it comes from. Go after dark.

steps.name_en: Swim to the gap under the bank
steps.text_en: The gap is under the pond's north-east bank. Swim across to it.
Inside the grotto under Mirror Pond, at the foot of the far wall.

ff07.summary_en: The charm was cut to fit something, and so was the Old Token. There's an old shrine in the south of the wood.

steps.name_en: Find where the charm and the token fit
steps.text_en: From the crossroads in the middle of Whisperwood, take the path south to the old stone shrine. The weeping angel stands in the middle of it.
Maren's house is on the west bank of the river, north of the bridge.

ff08.summary_en: Maren says the miners at Stonepeak keep old records. Dunn runs the camp.

steps.text_en: Take the main road east out of town, past the Forge and the Carpenter. It climbs up to Stonepeak.
There's a notice board by the road where you come in, and another at the miners' camp in the north-west.

steps.name_en: Ask Dunn about the old records
steps.text_en: Dunn is by the fire at the miners' camp, in the north-west of Stonepeak.
The Old Working is the mine mouth south of the tarn, west of the stream. Go in and take the shaft down.
On the lower level, make for the far south-west corner. It fell between two rocks at the end of a side passage.

steps.name_en: Bring Dunn his pick and ore
steps.text_en: Copper seams are the orange-flecked rocks in the Old Working. Stone comes from any plain rock. Pickaxes wear out: the Forge sells more.

ff09.summary_en: Dunn found his pick in the old foreman's house. Haskett left a strongbox with four numbers on its dial, and wrote them where he walked every day.

steps.text_en: Dunn is by the fire at the miners' camp, in the north-west of Stonepeak.
Tarn jetty: north of the camp. Cairn: the south ridge. Company board and graves: the ruined compound, up on the High Shelf to the east.
The strongbox is bolted down by Haskett's door, next to Dunn's fire at the camp.

ff10.summary_en: Haskett barred the Green Vein. His record says whoever opened his box has his leave, and that he went in.

steps.text_en: The Green Vein is the timbered drift behind the miners' camp, in the far north-west corner of Stonepeak.
Emerald wants a Gold pickaxe: there's one in the prospector's chest, at the back. Haskett's note is by the green pool.

ff11.summary_en: Haskett's note says the lever in the Gloom has lost its handle, and that Bram's father made the first.

steps.text_en: The Forge is just east of the town square, on the north side of the east road.
Emeralds come from the Green Vein, Copper Ore from the Old Working. Gold comes from selling crops, fish and ore.

ff12.summary_en: The lever is in the Gloom, three levels down. Haskett called it the red deep.

steps.text_en: The Gloom is at the far north end of the gorge that runs up the middle of Stonepeak. Haskett left its portcullis up.

steps.name_en: Go down to the red deep
steps.text_en: In the Gloom, take the stair in the north-east down to the drowned halls, then the stair in their far south-east down again.

steps.name_en: Fit the handle to the lever
steps.text_en: In the red deep, on the east wall. It's tucked behind a rock, out of the way.

ff13.summary_en: "The key went with the last cart. The watcher with its number keeps it." The quarry sent carts east to the compound on the delvers' last day. Not all of them got there.

steps.text_en: The quarry is the open pit in the middle of Stonepeak. The gate book is by the gargoyle at the compound's gate. The ruts run up the gorge.
The Delvers' Court is the stone yard in the north-east, up the steps from the High Shelf. Four hooded watchers stand in it.

ff14.summary_en: The Delvers' Key opens the Sunken Vault, under their court.

steps.text_en: The Sunken Vault is east of the Delvers' Court, at the far edge of the High Shelf. The key opens it now.
Take the stair down at the back of the vault.
Search the treasury's corners. The delvers didn't leave their record in the middle of the room.

ff15.summary_en: The delvers' record says the Founders tore their map in four. You have two of the pieces.

steps.text_en: Maren's house is on the west bank of the river, north of the bridge.
Nixie visits the pond in the south-east corner of town, below the Market Hall.
Golden Fish swim only in the river, in town or off your island, and they rarely bite. Keep casting.
Moonmere is up a north road from town. The Old Cave is the dark mouth in the cliff on its north-east ridge. It needs a Bronze pickaxe.
Inside the Old Cave, away from the water, in the far north-west corner.
Maren's house is on the west bank of the river, north of the bridge.

ff16.summary_en: The Founders' Map shows Moonmere and an X. Read it and find the place yourself.

steps.name_en: Find the X on the map
steps.text_en: Nobody can show you this one. Hold the Founders' Map and press Space to read it, then go to Moonmere and dig where the X is.
The Forge is just east of the town square, on the north side of the east road.

steps.name_en: Bring Bram Gold Ore and 5,000 Gold
steps.text_en: Gold Ore is in the rock of the Sunken Vault's treasury, and it wants an Amethyst pickaxe. Bram is at the Forge.
Go back to the chest at the X on your map, at Moonmere, with the pry bar.

ff17.summary_en: The Founders' letter talks about someone at the lake they brought gifts to every year. Moonmere might tell you more.

steps.text_en: The Tide Stone by Marven's pool, a bottle in Driftwood Cove, a sunken boat, the houseboat on the east shore, a stump in Glowcap Hollow.

steps.name_en: Find the one beneath the water
steps.text_en: Marven's pool is up the stone stairs in the north-west of Moonmere, on the teal shelf.

ff18.summary_en: Marven wants what the Founders brought her every year, and what the delvers took.

steps.text_en: Marven's pool is up the stone stairs in the north-west of Moonmere, on the teal shelf.
In the Old Cave, in the shallows at the far end, north of the way in.
Star Fruit: the moonstone's seeds, Farming level 10. Ghost Catfish: Moonmere, at night. Rubies: the Gloom's red deep. Cook at any stove.

s_marlow.summary_en: Marlow has taken on a patch by the greenhouse and wants to see it earn its keep.

steps.text_en: Marlow's house is west of the river, south of the main road, near the allotments.
The fields are north of the town square, by the glass greenhouse.
Marlow's house is west of the river, south of the main road.

s_hollis.summary_en: One of Hollis's hens has gone missing again.

steps.text_en: Hollis is on the east edge of town, south of the east road, by the houses there.
The orchard is at the north edge of town, above the mill. Look under the cherry trees.
Hollis is on the east edge of town, south of the east road.

s_silas1.summary_en: Silas the gravedigger keeps the graves of Gloamfen. One of them has no name, and that troubles him.

steps.text_en: Silas is by his hut, north of the graveyard, near the water.

steps.name_en: Look at the stone with no name
steps.text_en: The stone with no name stands west of the chapel, on its own, nearest the willows.

steps.name_en: Look in the chapel's burial register
steps.text_en: The chapel is south of Silas's hut. The register is just inside its door.
Silas is by his hut, north of the graveyard.

s_silas2.summary_en: A ring was taken from one of the old barrows. Silas wants it given back before the barrow takes notice.

steps.text_en: Silas is by his hut, north of the graveyard.

steps.name_en: Find what the stilt folk hid
steps.text_en: The stilt village is on the water in the west. Look along the walk by the house in the north east of it.

steps.name_en: Give the ring back to the barrow
steps.text_en: The big barrow in the north west, on the isle above the village. Its door faces south.
Silas is by his hut, north of the graveyard.

s_silas3.summary_en: Silas wants a night's supper and a light for his lamp. In return he will give you something nobody else has.

steps.text_en: Silas is by his hut, north of the graveyard.

steps.name_en: Bring Silas a Marsh Eel and three Glowcaps
steps.text_en: Fish anywhere in the marsh after dark for an eel. Glowcaps glow at the dead trees' feet: pick them with E.

s_wren.summary_en: Wren remembers a fish nobody has seen in years.

steps.text_en: Wren's cottage is on the east bank of the river, down by the south jetties.
Tiger Trout are rare, but they bite anywhere with fish in it. Wren is at her cottage.

s_elsie.summary_en: Elsie wants to paint a butterfly, but they never sit still long enough.

steps.text_en: Elsie paints in the middle of town, at her easel between the General Store and the Bakery.
Butterflies flutter over the meadows and wherever flowers grow. Swing the net at one, then find Elsie at her easel.

s_juniper.summary_en: Juniper is running low on Silvercaps, and they only grow out in the wood.

steps.text_en: The Apothecary is the teal-roofed house on the far west side of town, north of the main road.
Silvercaps are the small pale blue mushrooms, thickest in Mushroom Hollow in the far west of Whisperwood.

s_bram.summary_en: Bram wants copper from the mountain.

steps.text_en: The Forge is just east of the town square, on the north side of the east road.
Copper seams are the orange-flecked rocks in the Old Working at Stonepeak, east of town.

s_tamsin.summary_en: Tamsin needs fresh ingredients for the week's baking.

steps.text_en: The Bakery is on the west bank, right by the bridge.
Hazel sells carrot and parsnip seeds. Grow them yourself, then take them to the Bakery.

s_pell.summary_en: Two planks are gone from the footbridge, and Pell needs timber to fix it.

steps.text_en: The Carpenter's workshop is on the east road, past the Forge.
Chop any tree with the axe. Pell is at his workshop on the east road.

s_hazel.summary_en: Hazel has heard about a wild plant out in Whisperwood that nobody here has ever grown.

steps.text_en: The Seed & Tool shop is just east of the town square, on the north side of the east road.

steps.name_en: Find seeds in the bramble patch
steps.text_en: The bramble patch is in the far north of Whisperwood, where the river comes down. Take the path north through the wood.
Hazel is at the Seed & Tool shop, just east of the square.

fg01.summary_en: Marlow says a farmer should always have something growing, whatever else is going on. Start with parsnips.

steps.text_en: Hazel's Seed & Tool shop sells the seeds. Plant them by the town greenhouse or at home. Needed by chapter 8. Seeds locked? Raise Farming.

fg02.summary_en: Wren cooks fish with spring onions, and the patch behind the cottage has gone to seed.

steps.text_en: Hazel's Seed & Tool shop sells the seeds. Plant them by the town greenhouse or at home. Needed by chapter 8. Seeds locked? Raise Farming.

fg03.summary_en: Hugo's mill is standing still. He needs wheat to grind.

steps.text_en: Hazel's Seed & Tool shop sells the seeds. Plant them by the town greenhouse or at home. Needed by chapter 8. Seeds locked? Raise Farming.

fg04.summary_en: Tamsin is short of potatoes for her pies.

steps.text_en: Hazel's Seed & Tool shop sells the seeds. Plant them by the town greenhouse or at home. Needed by chapter 8. Seeds locked? Raise Farming.

fg05.summary_en: Rowan says the Market Hall has had no greens all week.

steps.text_en: Hazel's Seed & Tool shop sells the seeds. Plant them by the town greenhouse or at home. Needed by chapter 8. Seeds locked? Raise Farming.

fg06.summary_en: Mabel says every kitchen needs onions hung up before the cold comes.

steps.text_en: Hazel's Seed & Tool shop sells the seeds. Plant them by the town greenhouse or at home. Needed by chapter 8. Seeds locked? Raise Farming.

fg07.summary_en: Hugo is grinding again and wants more wheat.

steps.text_en: Hazel's Seed & Tool shop sells the seeds. Plant them by the town greenhouse or at home. Needed by chapter 8. Seeds locked? Raise Farming.

fg08.summary_en: The miners at Stonepeak live on rice, and Dunn says the camp's store is nearly empty.

steps.text_en: Hazel's Seed & Tool shop sells the seeds. Plant them by the town greenhouse or at home. Needed by chapter 15. Seeds locked? Raise Farming.

fg09.summary_en: Dunn says his miners haven't seen a green vegetable in weeks.

steps.text_en: Hazel's Seed & Tool shop sells the seeds. Plant them by the town greenhouse or at home. Needed by chapter 15. Seeds locked? Raise Farming.

fg10.summary_en: Juniper makes a salve from marigolds for the miners' hands.

steps.text_en: Juniper's Apothecary sells the seeds. Plant them by the town greenhouse or at home. Needed by chapter 15. Seeds locked? Raise Farming.

fg11.summary_en: The winch team works hungry. Corn keeps them going.

steps.text_en: Hazel's Seed & Tool shop sells the seeds. Plant them by the town greenhouse or at home. Needed by chapter 15. Seeds locked? Raise Farming.

fg12.summary_en: Juniper presses sunflower seeds for oil and has run out.

steps.text_en: Juniper's Apothecary sells the seeds. Plant them by the town greenhouse or at home. Needed by chapter 15. Seeds locked? Raise Farming.

fg13.summary_en: Tamsin is making a sauce and wants tomatoes.

steps.text_en: Hazel's Seed & Tool shop sells the seeds. Plant them by the town greenhouse or at home. Needed by chapter 15. Seeds locked? Raise Farming.

fg14.summary_en: It is hot on the deep levels. The miners want cucumbers.

steps.text_en: Hazel's Seed & Tool shop sells the seeds. Plant them by the town greenhouse or at home. Needed by chapter 15. Seeds locked? Raise Farming.

fg15.summary_en: Rowan says the Market Hall can never get enough beans.

steps.text_en: Hazel's Seed & Tool shop sells the seeds. Plant them by the town greenhouse or at home. Needed by chapter 18. Seeds locked? Raise Farming.

fg16.summary_en: Tamsin bakes red bean buns for the autumn fair.

steps.text_en: Hazel's Seed & Tool shop sells the seeds. Plant them by the town greenhouse or at home. Needed by chapter 18. Seeds locked? Raise Farming.

fg17.summary_en: The Founders grew more than Star Fruit. Their fields were full. Fill yours.

steps.text_en: Hazel's Seed & Tool shop sells the seeds. Plant them by the town greenhouse or at home. Needed by chapter 18. Seeds locked? Raise Farming.

bk01.summary_en: You woke in a bed that isn't yours. There is a smell of soup, and somebody moving about the house.

steps.name_en: Talk to the man in the house
steps.text_en: The old man is here in the house with you. Walk up to him and press E to talk.

bk02.summary_en: Marlow wants to see you grow something before he leaves the island to you.

steps.text_en: Marlow is standing by the path just outside your front door. The field is the patch of bare earth west of the house.

steps.name_en: Turn the soil in the field
steps.text_en: The field is the patch of bare earth west of the house. Take the hoe in hand and press Space. One swing turns a whole row.
Take the seeds in hand from your hotbar, stand on the turned soil and press Space.

steps.name_en: Tell Marlow the seeds are in
steps.text_en: Marlow is standing by the path just outside your front door.

bk03.summary_en: The carrots are in. While they grow, Marlow teaches you the rest of what he knows.

steps.text_en: Take the can to your carrots west of the house and press Space. If it has rained, that counts too.

steps.name_en: Ask Marlow what to do while they grow
steps.text_en: Marlow is standing by the path just outside your front door.

steps.name_en: Catch a fish off the island
steps.text_en: Stand at the island's shore facing the water, rod in hand. Hold Space to cast.

steps.name_en: Harvest a carrot with the sickle
steps.text_en: When the carrots have come up, stand by them with the sickle in hand and press Space.

steps.name_en: Put something away in a chest in the house
steps.text_en: The chests are in the house, two by the fireplace, a crate and one by the bed. Press E at one and drag something in.
Marlow is standing by the path just outside your front door.

bk04.summary_en: Marlow has taught you what he can on the island. Bloomshire is across the water, and he is going with you.

steps.text_en: Marlow is standing by the path just outside your front door.
The rowing boat is tied up on the south shore of the island, below the house. Stand next to it and press E.

bk05.summary_en: Bloomshire. Everybody seems to know who you are already.

steps.name_en: Talk to Marlow on the jetty
steps.text_en: Marlow is on the jetty where the boat came in, at the south end of town by the river.
Maren lives west of the river, north of the bridge. Fenwick's post is north of the square. The Bakery is by the bridge.
Marlow's new house is west of the river, south of the main road, near the allotments.

bk06.summary_en: Marlow says you need a routine. Meet the shopkeepers, grow something in town, and sell it.

steps.name_en: Ask Marlow about a day's work
steps.text_en: Marlow's new house is west of the river, south of the main road, near the allotments.
Hazel, Bram and Pell are east of the square. Odette is west of it. Wren's cottage is by the south jetties.
Hazel's shop is just east of the square. The town fields are north of the square, by the greenhouse.
Marlow's new house is west of the river, south of the main road, near the allotments.

bk07.summary_en: Ansel the chapel keeper wants to show you the twelve statues down by the harbour.

steps.name_en: Talk to Ansel at the chapel
steps.text_en: Ansel keeps the old chapel, north west of the square past the orchard.
The Founders' Walk runs south from the Founders' Hall, by the harbour, at the south end of town.
Rosa reads on the west bank by the river, south of the main road.

bk08.summary_en: The school children have a skipping rhyme about a red star. Greta doesn't like it.

steps.name_en: Talk to Greta at the school
steps.text_en: Greta's school is in the north east of town.
The pond is just south of the square, by the Market Hall.

steps.name_en: Talk to Nixie in the pond
steps.text_en: Nixie is in the pond just south of the square. Stand by the water and press E.
Nothing to do here. On you go.

steps.name_en: Bring Nixie a piece of Quartz
steps.text_en: Quartz is in the Old Working, the mine in Stonepeak east of town. Break the pale seams. Nixie is in the pond south of the square.

bk09.summary_en: Old Jory says there's a fish in the bay as big as a boat. Nobody believes him.

steps.text_en: Jory sits by the river, south west of the square.
Nothing to do here. On you go.

steps.name_en: Catch five fish in the bay
steps.text_en: The bay is at the far south of the map, past the south of town and the Southvale. Fish off the dock or the Long Pier.

steps.name_en: Watch the water from the end of the pier at night
steps.text_en: The end of the Long Pier, in the bay at the far south. Only at night.
Jory sits by the river, south west of the square.

bk10.summary_en: Otto the lamplighter needs a favour, and he is too shy to say what it is.

steps.text_en: Otto is by the Seed & Tool, just east of the square.
Nothing to do here. On you go.

steps.name_en: Give Ivy a marigold you grew, from Otto
steps.text_en: Grow a marigold, then take it to Ivy. Ivy sells flowers just south of the square.
Otto is by the Seed & Tool, just east of the square.

bk11.summary_en: Something is wrong in Dara's orchard.

steps.name_en: Talk to Dara in the orchard
steps.text_en: Dara keeps the orchard north of the square.
The orchard is north of the square. The grey corner is at its north west.
Hollis keeps the animals on the east side of town.
Maren's house is on the west bank of the river, north of the bridge.

steps.name_en: Bring Ansel and Hugo to Maren
steps.text_en: Ansel keeps the old chapel, north west of the square past the orchard. Hugo is by the orchard, north west of the square.
Maren's house is on the west bank of the river, north of the bridge.

bk12.summary_en: The evenings are coming early. Otto asks for help with the lamps.

steps.text_en: Otto is by the Seed & Tool, just east of the square.
The jetty road lamp is at the south end of town, the chapel lamp north west, the west road lamp where the road leaves for the wood.
Nothing to do here. On you go.

steps.name_en: Drive off the grey wolf in Whisperwood
steps.text_en: Grey wolves hunt in Whisperwood, west of town. Sword in hand, Space to strike.
Otto is by the Seed & Tool, just east of the square.

bk13.summary_en: The grey is coming out of the wood. Cole knows Whisperwood better than anyone, and he will go with you, partway.

steps.text_en: Cole works by the greenhouse fields, north of the square.
Nothing to do here. On you go.

steps.name_en: Fell five trees in the Woodlot
steps.text_en: The Woodlot is the fenced grove just north of Pell's workshop, in town.

steps.name_en: Find the grey in the deep wood
steps.text_en: The deep wood is the dark west of Whisperwood. The grey clearing is about halfway down it, west of the woodcutters' clearing.
Cole works by the greenhouse fields, north of the square.

bk14.summary_en: The grey runs north through the deep wood, towards an old place Cole's father called the hidden glade.

steps.text_en: The hidden glade is at the north of the deep wood, in the north west of Whisperwood. Look for a ring of old columns round a floor of stone.
Rosa reads on the west bank by the river, south of the main road.
Nothing to do here. On you go.
The Apothecary is in the far west of town, on the main road before the wood.

bk15.summary_en: Rosa has found the map. Marlow and Maren argue about what it means. Somebody has to go and look.

steps.text_en: Rosa reads on the west bank by the river, south of the main road.
Marlow's new house is west of the river, south of the main road, near the allotments.
Maren's house is on the west bank of the river, north of the bridge.
Nothing to do here. On you go.

steps.name_en: Cook five dishes for the road
steps.text_en: Any stove will do, the Bakery's by the bridge or yours in the house on the island.
The Bakery is on the west bank, right by the bridge, on the north side of the main road.

bk16.summary_en: The Old Road runs west for days, to a ring of stones on an old map.

steps.text_en: The Old Road leaves the far west edge of Whisperwood, at the end of the main road through the wood.
They stand round the old pavement. "Red star rising": the red one first, then on round the way the ring's colours run.

steps.name_en: Step into the middle of the ring
steps.text_en: All twelve are awake, and the middle of the old pavement is glowing. Stand in it and press E.

bk17.summary_en: You walk home not knowing what happened to you at the ring of stones.

steps.text_en: The Old Road leads back from the south of the Dreaming Fields to Whisperwood, and the town beyond it.
Marlow's new house is west of the river, south of the main road, near the allotments.
Maren's house is on the west bank of the river, north of the bridge.

bk18.summary_en: Up the river to the lake. The mermaid of Moonmere asked for you by name, and the lake's fish are coming up grey.

steps.text_en: Moonmere is the lake north of town. Walk north from the square until you reach the water.
Marven's pool is in the north east corner of Moonmere, below the falls.
Fish anywhere on Moonmere. The lagoon's long pier and the meadow shore are good spots.

steps.name_en: Fish the far shores, sixty more
steps.text_en: Marven wants every corner of the lake fished. Try the falls shelf, the Stone Ring and the meadow shore.
Ghost Catfish bite only in Moonmere, at night. Marven's pool is in the north east corner of Moonmere, below the falls.
Marven's pool is in the north east corner of Moonmere, below the falls. She asked for a day to think.

bk19.summary_en: Twelve stones stand in a ring out in the lake. Marven says their marks only show at night.

steps.name_en: Read the four marked stones at night
steps.text_en: One marked stone on each side of the Stone Ring, in the middle of Moonmere. Stepping stones go out from the meadow. At night.
Rosa reads on the west bank by the river, south of the main road.
Rosa reads on the west bank by the river, south of the main road. She asked for a whole day with the rubbings.

steps.name_en: Pick forty things that grow wild
steps.text_en: Mushrooms in the wood and round the lake. Juniper wants to know you can find things before she makes you a lantern.
Glowcaps grow round Moonmere and in Whisperwood. The Apothecary is in the far west of town, on the main road before the wood.

bk20.summary_en: Nixie has lived in the town pond longer than anyone remembers. Nobody ever told her where she came from.

steps.text_en: The pond is just south of the square, by the Market Hall.
Marven's pool is in the north east corner of Moonmere, below the falls.
Cook at any stove. The Bakery's by the bridge, or use yours on the island.

steps.name_en: Bring Nixie ten dishes you cooked
steps.text_en: The pond is just south of the square, by the Market Hall.
The pond is just south of the square, by the Market Hall.

bk21.summary_en: The merfolk of the lagoon village are polite to strangers, and nothing more. You carry a comb that might change that.

steps.name_en: Find the speaker for the lagoon
steps.text_en: Sylmare is by the shell fountain in the lagoon village, on the west side of Moonmere.

steps.name_en: Show Sylmare the comb and the lantern
steps.text_en: Sylmare is by the shell fountain in the lagoon village, on the west side of Moonmere.

steps.name_en: Bring Miralys thirty fish for the drying racks
steps.text_en: Miralys mends nets by the canoe on the lagoon village's east walk, west of Moonmere.

steps.name_en: Bring Elyria marigolds for the fountain
steps.text_en: Elyria sings by the shell fountain in the lagoon village, on the west side of Moonmere.

steps.name_en: Drive the slimes and flytraps off the shore
steps.text_en: They are along the shores of Moonmere, thickest in the meadow on the south side.

steps.name_en: Tell Virella the shore is clear
steps.text_en: Virella keeps watch by the long pier out to the lagoon village, west of Moonmere.

steps.name_en: Bring Sylmare what the walks need
steps.text_en: Sylmare is by the shell fountain in the lagoon village, on the west side of Moonmere.
Sylmare is by the shell fountain in the lagoon village, on the west side of Moonmere. Come back tomorrow.

bk22.summary_en: Something big and grey moves in the deep water of the lake. It took two of Miralys's nets, and a canoe.

steps.text_en: Virella keeps watch by the long pier out to the lagoon village, west of Moonmere.

steps.name_en: Watch the deep water at night
steps.text_en: Watch from the stepping stones that run out to the Stone Ring from the meadow on the south shore. At night.

steps.name_en: Fish the deep water, sixty more
steps.text_en: To be ready for anything that big you need hours on the water. Anywhere on Moonmere.
Round Moonmere.
Ghost Catfish bite only in Moonmere, at night. Marven's pool is in the north east corner of Moonmere, below the falls.
Virella keeps watch by the long pier out to the lagoon village, west of Moonmere. Come back tomorrow.

bk23.summary_en: The Moon Fairy kept the lake before the merfolk came. Her shrine stands on the island east of the lake, and she shows herself only to someone she chooses.

steps.text_en: Elyria sings by the shell fountain in the lagoon village, on the west side of Moonmere.

steps.name_en: Pick fifty things that grow wild
steps.text_en: Anything that grows wild, anywhere. She likes people who notice.
Elyria sings by the shell fountain in the lagoon village, on the west side of Moonmere.

steps.name_en: Take the offering to the shrine at night
steps.text_en: The Moon Fairy's shrine is the little gazebo on the island on the east side of Moonmere. Swim across to it.

steps.name_en: Find what the moon shows you
steps.text_en: At night, with the Moon Fairy's blessing. Three places round the lake shine for you now.
Elyria sings by the shell fountain in the lagoon village, on the west side of Moonmere.

bk24.summary_en: A song nobody has sung for a hundred years. To sing it the whole lake must listen, the town and the lagoon together.

steps.text_en: Elyria sings by the shell fountain in the lagoon village, on the west side of Moonmere. Come back tomorrow.
Maren's house is on the west bank of the river, north of the bridge.

steps.name_en: Bring Tamsin twenty dishes for the feast
steps.text_en: The Bakery is on the west bank, right by the bridge, on the north side of the main road.
Ivy sells flowers just south of the square.

steps.name_en: Bring Hugo sixty wheat for the bread
steps.text_en: Hugo is by the orchard, north west of the square.

steps.name_en: Bring Otto glowcaps and Gold for the lanterns
steps.text_en: Otto is by the Seed & Tool, just east of the square.

steps.name_en: Tell Sylmare the town is coming
steps.text_en: Sylmare is by the shell fountain in the lagoon village, on the west side of Moonmere.
Elyria sings by the shell fountain in the lagoon village, on the west side of Moonmere. Come back tomorrow.

steps.name_en: Go to the festival at the fountain at night
steps.text_en: The shell fountain is in the middle of the lagoon village, on the west side of Moonmere. At night.

steps.name_en: Talk to Maren after the festival
steps.text_en: Maren's house is on the west bank of the river, north of the bridge.

g_storehouse.summary_en: Marlow says the Storehouse in town keeps a chest for you, for when your hands are full.

steps.name_en: Put something in your chest at the Storehouse
steps.text_en: The Storehouse is on the east side of town, south of the Bank. Inside, press E at your chest and drag something in.

g_fish.summary_en: Wren the fisher will show you how to really fish.

steps.text_en: Wren's cottage is by the south jetties.
Any water with fish will do, the river through town, the pond or the bay to the south.
Wren's cottage is by the south jetties.

g_cook.summary_en: Tamsin says anybody can cook if they stand at a stove long enough.

steps.text_en: The Bakery is on the west bank, right by the bridge, on the north side of the main road.
Stand at the stove in the Bakery and press E. Fried Fish takes one Carp.
The Bakery is on the west bank, right by the bridge, on the north side of the main road.

g_forage.summary_en: Juniper at the Apothecary knows everything that grows wild in the valley.

steps.text_en: The Apothecary is in the far west of town, on the main road before the wood.
In Whisperwood's shade, west of town. Press E by a mushroom.
The Apothecary is in the far west of town.

g_wood.summary_en: Cole the farmhand will show you how to fell a tree without dropping it on yourself.

steps.text_en: Cole works by the greenhouse fields, north of the square.

steps.name_en: Fell five trees in the Woodlot
steps.text_en: The Woodlot is the fenced grove just north of Pell's workshop, in town. Axe in hand, press Space by a tree.
Cole works by the greenhouse fields, north of the square.

g_woodlot.summary_en: Pell keeps the only trees in Bloomshire anyone may cut. They grow back, if you give them time.

steps.text_en: Pell's workshop is on the east road, past the Forge.

steps.name_en: Fell all six trees in the Woodlot
steps.text_en: The Woodlot is the fenced grove just north of Pell's workshop, in town.

steps.name_en: Come back when they have grown, and fell all six again
steps.text_en: The Woodlot is the fenced grove just north of Pell's workshop, in town. A felled tree there is a tree again in six hours.
Pell's workshop is on the east road, past the Forge.

g_mine.summary_en: Bram at the Forge will teach you to work a pickaxe.

steps.name_en: Talk to Bram at the Forge
steps.text_en: The Forge is east of the square.
Stonepeak, east of town. Pickaxe in hand, press Space by a rock.
The Forge is east of the square.

g_combat.summary_en: Bram says a farmer who walks in the wild had better know how to use a sword.

steps.text_en: The Forge is east of the square.
Out in the wild, Whisperwood to the west or Stonepeak to the east.
The Forge is east of the square.

g_market.summary_en: Rowan runs the Market Hall, where farmers sell to each other. There are rules.

steps.name_en: Talk to Rowan at the Market Hall
steps.text_en: The Market Hall is just south of the square.

steps.name_en: Put something up for sale on a stall
steps.text_en: In the Market Hall, south of the square. Talk to Rowan and choose something to sell.

g_orders.summary_en: Odette keeps a board of orders at the General Store, six a day.

steps.text_en: The General Store is just west of the square.

steps.name_en: Deliver an order at the General Store
steps.text_en: At the General Store, west of the square. Talk to Odette and open the Orders tab.

g_bank.summary_en: Farthing at the Bank keeps your Gold safe.

steps.name_en: Talk to Farthing at the Bank
steps.text_en: The Bank is on the east side of town.

steps.name_en: Put some Gold in the Bank
steps.text_en: At the Bank, east side of town. Talk to Farthing.

g_explore.summary_en: Rosa wants you to see the valley for yourself, all of it, and tell her what it is really like.

steps.text_en: Rosa reads on the west bank by the river, south of the main road.

steps.name_en: Walk into every part of the valley
steps.text_en: Whisperwood is west, Moonmere up the river north, Stonepeak east, the Southvale and the bay south.
Rosa reads on the west bank by the river, south of the main road.

sd_fenwick.summary_en: Fenwick's knees are bad and his bag is full.

steps.name_en: Talk to Fenwick at the post
steps.text_en: Fenwick keeps the post just north of the town square.

Lena keeps the gardens south west of town, near Marlow's house.
Fenwick keeps the post just north of the town square.

steps.text_en: Hugo is by the orchard, north west of the square.

steps.text_en: Lena keeps the gardens south west of town, near Marlow's house.

steps.text_en: Lena keeps the gardens south west of town, near Marlow's house.

steps.text_en: The pond is just south of the square, by the Market Hall.

sd_ivy.summary_en: Ivy wants a marigold on every table in the square for the summer dance.

steps.name_en: Bring Wren ten fish and five wood
steps.text_en: Wren's cottage is by the south jetties.

sd_cole.summary_en: Winter is coming and the town woodpile is low.

steps.text_en: Cole works by the greenhouse fields, north of the square.

sd_juniper.summary_en: Juniper's shelves are bare of mushrooms, and people are coughing.

steps.name_en: Bring Juniper ten silvercaps and five glowcaps

steps.text_en: The Forge is east of the square. Copper is in Stonepeak's caves, iron deeper down, from Mining level 5.

sd_rhys.summary_en: Something has been at the town's fields at night, and Rhys is tired of it.

sd_farthing.summary_en: Three pages have gone from Farthing's ledger, and Farthing does not lose things.

sd_rowan.summary_en: Rowan wants the Market Hall busy, and it has been very quiet.
